name: Semine Airi
source: A very strange girl that even her friend Shino seems to think so, nobody knows what she is thinking. She will suddenly moves into their faces and begin to utter nonsense. She has winning experiences in the national badminton assembly, and is well known in student athlete circles. Has a big appetite. Because she eats a lot, her chest is growing well.
